QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_70

question.text: The risk management framework for commodity index futures and index options conforms to:

answer.text: CPMI-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructure (PFMI)

explanation.text: The Logic: The risk management framework for commodity index futures and index options conforms to the CPMI-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructure (PFMI), including a 99% VaR initial-margin requirement and prescribed Margin Period of Risk (MPOR). The Trap: SEBI regulations apply domestically, but the underlying framework is the international PFMI; it is not IMF or World Bank guidance. The PFMI reference at this point in the workbook is specifically for the commodity index futures/options framework. Note: The 99% VaR floor means initial margin should cover the loss expected to be exceeded on no more than 1% of days, and the MPOR sets the assumed time required to close out a defaulting member's position.
